editorial: For the classic Lima-Cusco-Machu Picchu route, the dry Andean months are the easiest bet, especially if clear mountain views matter to you.
The trade-off is obvious: better weather attracts more people. Shoulder months can give you a better balance if you are willing to tolerate a little uncertainty.
Whatever month you choose, remember that Lima and Cusco can feel like different countries climatically. Pack for both.
